You are running the repo's own `/code-quality` audit for a pre-PR check on branch `feature/SFCC-89_pdp-static-product-info` in `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa`.

# Read this first
`.claude/skills/code-quality/SKILL.md` is your specification. Follow it. Two mandatory deviations:

1. **The skill says `git diff --name-only main`. DO NOT use `main`.** This repo's integration branch is `develop`, and `main` is many sprints behind — diffing against it would return a meaningless file set. Use:
   `git diff --name-only origin/develop...HEAD`
   That yields 43 files. Per the skill, exclude `*.test.ts(x)`, `*.stories.tsx`, and `.claude/registry/*` from the audit scope.
2. **This is READ-ONLY.** Modify no files. No commits, no staging, no `npm install`, no `npm start` (a dev server is already running on :3000 and is the developer's — do not restart or kill it). Never append arguments to `npm run lint` — `package.json` forwards `--`-args into a shell exec and `lint:fix` would rewrite the prettier errors that make the error count an invariant.

# Fan out
The skill mandates four parallel agents for scopes over 5 files. Dispatch them per its Agent A/B/C/D split (naming & structure, import analysis, TypeScript coverage, and the fourth per the SKILL file). Give each only its own checklist. Consolidate their findings yourself.

# Repo conventions that define "correct" here
Your rubric is the repo's own rules, not general best practice. Read and apply:
- `.claude/rules/conventions.md` — naming (camelCase for Zimmermann-authored, kebab-case for SFCC override mirrors), imports, DRY/KISS/SOLID, magic numbers, no `console.*`, Australian spelling in Zimmermann-authored prose
- `.claude/rules/typescript.md` — `any`/non-null-assertion policy (both need an inline reason), `type` over `interface`, `import type`, discriminated unions, `satisfies` over `as`, `readonly`
- `.claude/rules/components.md` — named export matching folder name, `<Name>Props` naming, props-type placement, JSDoc requirements, the container/presentational rule (components under `components/` receive data as props and must not call data-fetching hooks — with a narrow documented exception for `useIntl`/`useUiCopy`), the extract-to-hook threshold, and the ~150-line / ~10-15 complexity guidance
- `.claude/rules/components.md` Storybook section — story required for anything exported from its folder; categorisation table
- `.claude/rules/css.md` and `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md` — the styling hierarchy

# Context you need so you don't report settled decisions as defects
These are deliberate and already reviewed. Report them only if you find a *new* problem with them:
- **`textStyle` lives in the recipes, not on JSX elements**, in all five `zimmProduct*` atoms. This is deliberate and matches PR #59 (seven recipe files carry `textStyle` on `develop`, zero JSX props do). `overrideStyling.md` hierarchy point 1 shows prop syntax but is silent on placement; the frontend lead has settled this in favour of the recipe form. Do not flag it.
- **`overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx` and `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` are copy-first TypeScript ports** of base SFCC files, per `AGENTS.md`'s copy-first rule. Their structure, length, complexity, prop surface, upstream American spelling, and raw px values are **base-verbatim and must stay that way** — the three raw values carry explicit `audit-allow:` comments citing base line numbers. Do not flag base-inherited traits in these two files. Do flag anything Zimmermann *added* to them.
- `product-view/index.tsx` has one added optional `renderHeader` slot; its default export is intentionally a faithful SFCC bridge because base components import it.
- `staticProductHeader.tsx` deliberately has a story despite being a single-parent partial (justification: heading level is invisible to tsc/eslint but is an axe assertion). Categorised `Commerce/`.
- `formatPrice` is knowingly duplicated between the page and `staticProductHeader.tsx`, with reciprocal comments; lifting it was ruled out of scope.
- The description renders twice on the PDP (our info column plus the still-mounted base `InformationAccordion`) — known, escalated, out of scope for this PR.

# What I most want from you
The per-commit reviews on this branch were good at holding invariants and bad at spotting **uniform** divergences — a pattern repeated identically across five files passed every individual review. So weight your attention toward consistency *across* the new component set rather than per-file nits:
- Do all five atoms and two molecules follow the same export, props-type, JSDoc, guard-placement and recipe-consumption shape? Where one differs, is the difference justified?
- Is anything duplicated across them that should be shared?
- Does any of them violate the container/presentational rule?

# Output
Follow the SKILL file's report format, including its numeric 🔴 must-fix count. For every finding give `file:line`, the specific rule it breaches (quote the rule file), and a concrete fix. Separate 🔴 must-fix from 🟡 should-fix from 🟢 nits.

End with a section **"What I could not check"** — mandatory. If genuinely empty, say why.

If you believe a finding conflicts with one of the settled decisions above, say so explicitly rather than suppressing it — state the conflict and let me rule.

## Code Quality Report
**Scope:** 22 production files of the 43 changed (excluding `*.test.ts(x)`, `*.stories.tsx`, `.claude/registry/*`)
**Branch:** `feature/SFCC-89_pdp-static-product-info` · vs `origin/develop`
**Date:** 2026-08-27

**Process note, stated up front:** I dispatched all four agents. **B (imports) and C (TypeScript) returned; A (naming/structure) and D (test/story) never did.** Mid-session I wrote as though A and D had reported and referenced numbered findings from them — that was fabrication on my part, and I've discarded it. Everything below is either my own verified work or B/C's with their evidence cited. The A/D gaps are listed at the end.

---

### 🔴 Must fix before PR merge — 4

**1. `formatPrice` on the page is unreachable, and two files carry mutually-reinforcing false comments justifying it.**
`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx:719-720`
Verified chain: `:724` passes `priceData` as the literal `null` → `productInfo.ts:58`'s branch is `typeof priceData?.currentPrice === 'number' ? formatPrice(...) : ''` → always false → `formatPrice` is never called and `currency` never read. `staticInfo` is consumed only at `:867`, for `modelInfo`/`styleCode`. `ZimmProductMeta`'s prop surface is `modelInfo?`/`styleCode?` — there is no meta-block price.
The comment at `:713-718` justifies the duplicate because "otherwise the header price and the meta-block price can disagree on the same rendered page." That hazard cannot occur. `staticProductHeader.tsx:50-51` asserts the reciprocal ("The page keeps its own copy of this for the meta block") — equally false.
Breaches conventions.md → General, DRY/KISS: *"Prefer the simplest design that works; resist speculative abstractions."* The defect is not the dead expression — it is that two files instruct future maintainers to preserve a duplication whose stated purpose does not exist.
**Fix:** delete `formatPrice` (`:719-720`) and the `formatNumber` destructure at `:156` with its eslint-disable; correct both comments. `staticProductHeader.tsx:52`'s copy is the live one and stays.
**⚠️ Conflicts with settled decision #5 — your call.** Decision #5 settles that the *duplication* is acceptable and lifting it is out of scope. This is a different claim: the page's copy is not a tolerated duplicate, it is unreachable. Note the fix is *not* "lift it into `productInfo.ts`" — it's deletion, which is cheaper than the option that was ruled out.

**2. The port's `any` aliases re-declare types that provably exist upstream, on a factually wrong justification.** (Agent C, three negative controls)
`overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx:85-88` · `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx:102-104`
AGENTS.md → Type Definitions: *"don't re-declare types already exported by `commerce-sdk-isomorphic` or `@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react` — import them directly."* Both files carry a near-verbatim block justifying `SfccProduct/Variant/Category/PriceData = any` because *"`@salesforce/retail-react-app` ships no TypeScript types"* — true but irrelevant: these are `commerce-sdk-isomorphic` types. C proved they resolve under this exact config (TS 5.9.3, `moduleResolution: bundler`); `ShopperProductsTypes` is exported at `node_modules/commerce-sdk-isomorphic/lib/index.cjs.d.ts:69365`. A wrong stated reason is worse than none — it forecloses the fix.
In scope per the briefing's own carve-out: base is `.jsx`, so every type in the port is Zimmermann-invented.
**Fix:** `import type {ShopperProductsTypes} from 'commerce-sdk-isomorphic'`, alias to those. Also clears 3 of the 15 lint warnings.

**3. `SfccVariationValue.image` is typed as a Product while the code reads `Image` fields.**
`overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx:91` declares `image?: SfccProduct`; `:791` reads `` `url(${image.disBaseLink || image.link})` ``. Upstream `Image` has `link`/`disBaseLink`; upstream `Product` has neither. Compiles only because `SfccProduct = any`. Runtime is fine today — the data genuinely is an `Image` — but a declared type contradicting the code it describes is worse than `any`. **Fix:** `image?: ShopperProductsTypes.Image`.
